title: Navy’s GARC Kamikaze Drone Boat Blew A Hole In Ex-USS Peleliu During Sinking Exercise
summary: During a RIMPAC sinking exercise, the Navy's GARC kamikaze drone boat successfully struck the decommissioned USS Peleliu, creating a significant hole. This demonstration occurred shortly after the Navy's first combat deployment of a kamikaze Unmanned Surface Vessel (USV).

title: Aerostar High-Altitude Balloons Being Turned Into Drone Motherships
summary: Aerostar high-altitude balloons are being developed into drone motherships, capable of operating in the stratosphere. These platforms could provide persistent surveillance over large areas and potentially launch drones for on-demand attacks.

title: Inside Ukraine’s Long-Range Strike Campaign with the AGM-188A Rusty Dagger
summary: Recovered missile debris, specifically a Controlled Reception Pattern Antenna (CRPA) from a "Rusty Dagger" missile, provides insight into Ukraine's long-range strike campaign. The antenna was traced to Zone 5 Technologies, now owned by Norway's Kongsberg, highlighting the operational impact of this high-survivability weapon.

title: Laser air defenses will be operational before decade’s end, Lockheed exec says
summary: A Lockheed Martin executive stated that laser air defense systems are expected to be operational before the end of the decade. This statement challenges the long-standing perception that such systems are perpetually "five years away."

title: India moves closer to a homegrown, long-range air defense
summary: India has conducted a recent interceptor test, marking a significant step towards developing its own long-range air defense system. This indigenous system aims to rival the capabilities of Russia's S-400.
